_comment: Cycle-scoped override for the 2026-08-10 refresh (PR #477 review). The generic 'mixed' REL template asserts 'Bitcoin leads on part of the board', which is false this cycle: REL-01 and REL-02 are both INACTIVE and the group's single point is REL-03 (the Nasdaq's own structural health). composeMixed() cannot compose (supportive set empty) and falls back to the generic template — a template-library edge case. REMOVE this override when the 'mixed with no BTC-relative wins' template variant lands (market-data branch, Part B), or at the next cycle if the REL state changes. Stale-override hazard: nothing auto-clears this file between cycles.
